items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: And Percy Woods was singing with us at the time.

ctx.x: That's a really unbelievable story, isn't it?

And he reached back in the book and said, 'I'll get Little Gizzard. Play this.' And when we pulled out the music and I went right through it, and he said, 'Doggone, Gizzard.' And that was my man. He was my man from then on. I could wake Louis up any hour of the night when nobody would dare. I would knock on the door. And Percy Woods was singing with us at the time. Remember Percy Woods, the tenor?
